title: Blockworks: Core Loop
summary: Plan, place, label, and revise structures so survival spaces stay readable.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Collect or craft a material family, cut useful patterns, mark route infrastructure, and reinforce the places where expeditions begin and end.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each build pass, check whether a tired player could read entrances, storage, routes, and danger zones at a glance.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop before decoration consumes survival stock. A marked path, lit room, and clear storage wall beat an unfinished showpiece.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
